repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
fired := false
if (fired == true) {
    wait until((#Hall_Motion).motionSensor_motion == false)
    fired = false
}
wait until((#Hall_Motion).motionSensor_motion == true)
(#Hall_Light).light_moveToBrightness(100, 0)
delay(3 SEC)
(#Hall_Light).light_moveToBrightness(0, 0)
fired = true

diagnosis.summary: The candidate polls the motion sensor only at the start of the 1-second cycle period. The IR requires a rising-edge wait, meaning it must block until the transition from false to true occurs. Evidence F2 shows the input became true at 100ms, but the candidate emitted no action because its `if` guard evaluated to false at t=0 and the rising edge was missed.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic polling `if` with a rising-edge state machine using `wait until` and a `fired` flag. This ensures the script blocks until the motion sensor transitions to true, then executes the body, and re-arms for the next rising edge.
